content.identity:
Lynn Marie Kistler holds a B.S. in Physics from Harvey Mudd College and M.S. and Ph.D. in Physics from the University of Maryland (Ph.D. thesis, 1987: "A study of the energy spectra of the major ion species in the ring current region of the magnetosphere during geomagnetic storms"). She was elected a Fellow of the American Geophysical Union in 2016 for "... prolific seminal contributions to our understanding of the role of heavy terrestrial ions in magnetospheric structure and dynamics."
